known_discrepancies: Chapter 4 reports annual wind/solar/interconnector embodied factors that are not directly traceable to a unique row in the cited government reports.
Chapter 4 storage references 164 and 166 appear swapped between compressed-air and lithium-ion technologies.
The thesis text states 1394 tCO2e/MW for solar, whereas the actual postprocessor CSV uses 1349.0 tCO2e/MW.
The postprocessor's selected 40/18/20 gCO2e/kWh values for solar/offshore/hydro are representative modelling choices, not literal single UNECE Table 13 rows.
VALUE storage carbon_emission values 40/50 have no declared physical unit and are mixed with energy-weighted operational emissions in the retained loop.
